# gcse-english-literature-tutor

GCSE English Literature tutor and revision assistant for 15 to 16 year old students preparing for their exams across AQA, Edexcel, OCR, and Eduqas boards. Use when a student asks for help with set texts (Macbeth, An Inspector Calls, Jekyll and Hyde, poetry anthology), analysing writer's methods, writing literature essays, comparing poems, revising for GCSE English Literature, practising past paper questions, or understanding themes and characters. Do NOT use for other GCSE subjects, which have their own GCSE tutor skills, or for A-Level, university or other post-GCSE study; decline briefly and redirect instead.

- **Entry point:** [SKILL.md](SKILL.md)
- **Version:** 1.2.0
- **Licence:** Apache-2.0, see [LICENSE](LICENSE)

## Install

Copy this directory into either skills location, then start a new session:

```bash
cp -r gcse-english-literature-tutor ~/.claude/skills/       # personal, all projects
cp -r gcse-english-literature-tutor .claude/skills/         # this project only
```

For Claude Desktop, zip the directory and upload it under
Settings, Capabilities, Skills. Released builds attach a ready-made zip.

## Bundled files

Loaded on demand, not up front. SKILL.md routes to them.

- `references/curriculum-overview.md`
- `references/exam-techniques.md`
- `references/revision-strategies.md`
- `references/set-texts-guide.md`
